messages:
Maya (PM): Heads-up: noticed mismatched phrasing between the in-product docs panel and the public docs during onboarding. Example: 'Pin model' vs 'Pin model version' — tripping up new users.

Kevin (Design): Also the panel's 'Learn more' link lands at the top of the docs. Should deep-link to the specific heading and make the CTA explicit.

Sylvia (DevEx): Our docs helper returns /docs/models. I can add fragment support so components call getDocLink('models', 'pin-model-version') -> /docs/models#pin-model-version.

Raj (Eng): I'll add fragment + optional ariaLabel support to the helper and ensure external links open target="_blank" with rel="noopener noreferrer". Will include unit tests.

Emma (A11y): Please add aria-label 'Opens documentation in a new tab' and make the external icon keyboard-focusable. Also add aria-controls to the inlay close button.

Maya (PM): Decision: standardize on 'Pin model version' across console and docs, deep-link with '#pin-model-version', open docs in a new tab, add aria attributes, and harmonize sentence case for inlay headings.

Kevin (Design): I'll change CTA to 'See pinning docs' and tighten spacing around the external icon (4px).

Sylvia (DevEx): I'll add the heading id in the docs, a short style guide note about sentence case, and a redirect for legacy top-level links.

Raj (Eng): ETA for helper change + tests: tomorrow AM. Also adding a small e2e that diffs console labels vs docs headings to prevent regressions.

DocBot: Note: linter rule 'require-doc-anchors' queued to warn when frontend references docs without fragment.

Maya (PM): Action items assigned. Post any other phrasing mismatches (e.g., dedicated vs reserved capacity) here. Closing loop after PRs land. :white_check_mark:
